description:
The heart of the execution phase: run every check in parallel, each in its own sandbox, against its own MCP endpoint, and collect the reported results. Per check: (1) create a CoW sandbox of the working tree (M3 `BoxedSandbox`); (2) resolve the dedicated MCP endpoint + `--mcp-config` (M4); (3) dispatch the injected `BoxedExecutor` (M2) with instructions + prompt (M5).
